Dan Koe’s $5M Mistake: What The Art of Focus Got Wrong (And How to Avoid It)

Dan Koe built a $5 million-a-year business with nothing but a keyboard—but when he self-published The Art of Focus, it backfired.

In this video, I’m breaking down exactly what went wrong with Dan’s book and what first-time authors can learn from it. This isn’t just a roast; this is a crash course in how to write a nonfiction book that builds your authority, solves real problems, and doesn’t disappoint your audience.

Whether you’re a solopreneur, thought leader, coach, or content creator looking to write a book as part of your personal brand, this breakdown will help you avoid common pitfalls and write a book that actually delivers.
